irac.issue: Whether the accused is entitled to the benefit of Section 4 of the Dowry Death Act, 1986, if the trial for the offence under Section 302 IPC was held within one year from the date of marriage.
irac.rule: Section 4 of the Dowry Death Act, 1986 provides a presumption of guilt against the accused if the trial for the offence under Section 302 IPC is held within one year from the date of marriage and it is shown that the deceased was subjected to cruelty for or in connection with any demand for dowry.
irac.application: The court held that if it is shown that the accused subjected the deceased to cruelty for or in connection with any demand for dowry and the trial for the offence under Section 302 IPC was held within one year from the date of marriage, then the accused is entitled to the benefit of Section 4 of the Dowry Death Act, 1986.
irac.conclusion: The court allowed the appeal and set aside the judgment of the High Court, remanding the case to the trial court for fresh trial.
